name: Nexa Silver Virtual Card
summary: An instant virtual crypto debit card designed for secure online shopping and international transfers, issued within 24 hours of purchase.

kyc.notes: Requirements as published by the provider; confirm during onboarding.

cons: Virtual card only, no physical card

faq.question: Does the Nexa Silver Virtual Card charge a monthly fee?
faq.answer: Yes. It charges US$3.99 per month. Card issuance is US$49.95.

faq.question: What are the foreign-exchange fees on the Nexa Silver Virtual Card?
faq.answer: There is no foreign-exchange markup on spending.
